title: When the Gravity Breaks Anew
author: Orsen Sterling
blurb: Zephyrine Quintana, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
